fenway-park.name: Fenway Park
fenway-park.desc: Fenway Park, a compact asymmetric baseball park: tall green left-field wall with a manual scoreboard, dirt infield, grass outfield, stands wrapping from foul pole to foul pole behind home plate, roof-mounted light towers

features: Green Monster: tall green left-field wall, 37 ft, much taller than the other outfield walls, with the manual scoreboard set into its base
Monster seats on top of the Green Monster, under three light towers
Asymmetric outfield: short left field, deep right-center, the triangle in deep center field
Pesky Pole: short right-field foul pole at the end of a low wall
Red grandstand seats set in green-painted steel; dark green bleacher seats in the outfield
Roof-mounted light towers along the grandstand roof and over the Monster
Red-brick exterior facade with arched windows on the street side
Grandstand roof with white roof boxes and the upper-level enclosed club along the infield
Center-field bleachers and the video board above them in center-right

wrigley-field.name: Wrigley Field
wrigley-field.desc: Wrigley Field, a classic urban baseball park: ivy-covered outfield walls, hand-operated green center-field scoreboard, double-deck grandstand wrapping foul pole to foul pole, bleachers in the outfield, dirt infield and grass outfield
wrigley-field.materials: mown grass, ivy, red clay infield dirt, painted foul lines, green-painted steel, brick, concrete

features: Hand-operated green center-field scoreboard with the flagpoles above it
Ivy-covered brick outfield walls
Bleachers wrapping the outfield, with video boards in left and right field
Double-deck grandstand wrapping from foul pole to foul pole behind home plate, with a low roof
Roof-mounted light standards on the grandstand roof
Red Wrigley Field marquee over the main entrance at Clark and Addison
Rooftop bleachers on the neighboring buildings across Waveland and Sheffield (excluded from the cutout)
Dark green seats and green steel

Brick-and-glass press box and suite towers above both sidelines
Yellow-and-blue Block M at midfield and blue end zones
Aluminum bench seating, no chairbacks in the bowl
Video boards with large frames above both end zones
Brick exterior wall with a navy fascia band around the bowl rim
Crisler Center (domed arena) next door, excluded from the cutout

landn-federal-credit-union-stadium.name: L&N Federal Credit Union Stadium
landn-federal-credit-union-stadium.desc: L&N Federal Credit Union Stadium, a fully closed football bowl with red seats, a tall brick-and-glass press box tower on the west sideline, an upper deck on the east side, an American football field with end zones and yard lines

End zone painted with the team name; field with white yard lines
Brick stair towers at the corners with team-color caps
Light towers above the east and west rims

lambeau-field.name: Lambeau Field
lambeau-field.desc: Lambeau Field, a closed oval football bowl of light gray bench seating with a dark green upper facade, brick piers and a glass atrium on the east side, a tall south end zone with a large video board, an American football field with end zones and yard lines

Retired-number signage on the north end zone facade (rendered as plain shapes)

sofi-stadium.name: SoFi Stadium
sofi-stadium.desc: SoFi Stadium, a football stadium under a single huge translucent curved canopy roof that sweeps low on one side, open sides with slender columns, an oval bowl sunk below ground, a lake along one side

Roof edge curving down low on one side and rising high on the other
Open sides under the roof: the stadium is not enclosed by walls
Oval bowl set deep below grade under the canopy
YouDome Infinity Screen: oval double-sided video board hanging from the roof center (visible through the canopy as a ring)
Adjacent performance venue under the same roof at one end
Lake in front of the stadium on the west side

madison-square-garden.name: Madison Square Garden

Shallow cable-suspended round roof, light gray
Rectangular glass-and-precast office building attached on the Eighth Avenue side

Ring of video screens along the base of the drum (plain colored panels, no text)
Square glass-and-steel bridges (walkways) visible as horizontal bands around the drum
